tool.name: ApplyMajorityFilter

param.name: input_raster
param.dialogReference: Classified raster to be filtered. Should be a single-band raster with integer class values from a classification tool.

param.name: output_raster
param.dialogReference: Path and name for the output filtered raster. The output will have the same spatial extent and resolution as the input but with smoothed class boundaries.

param.name: window_size
param.dialogReference: Size of the moving window in pixels (3, 5, 7, or 9). The filter examines pixels within this window and assigns the majority class value. Default: 3 (3×3 window). Larger windows produce more smoothing but may eliminate legitimate small features.

tool.summary: Apply a majority filter to smooth a classified raster by reducing isolated pixels and small patches. The filter replaces each pixel's value with the most common class value within a surrounding window, reducing "salt and pepper" noise while preserving larger contiguous areas.
tool.usage: Use this tool after classification to improve visual quality and reduce classification noise. The majority filter is handy for removing isolated misclassified pixels while maintaining the boundaries of larger land cover patches. Larger window sizes produce more aggressive smoothing but may eliminate small features.
